facts.summary: numeric engine contract defines operation numeric_features with input inputs/case.json and output outputs/numeric.json
category engine contract defines operation category_features with input inputs/case.json and output outputs/category.json
time engine contract defines operation time_features with input inputs/case.json and output outputs/time.json
union engine contract defines operation feature_union taking outputs of numeric, category, time engines as inputs
inputs/case.json contains records array with id key value category time fields and vocabulary list
README mandates stable interfaces: load_payload, transform, build_component; forbids modifying protected files
facts.quote: README.md、TASK.md、inputs/、contract.json、check_module.py、check.py、integrate.py以及适用的materialize.py、__init__.py、parser.py不可修改。初始输入和契约为任务规格，不是可以修正的错误数据。

facts.summary: check_module asserts payloads/contract not mutated and result structure matches name/result dict
run_all.py and final_report.py currently raise NotImplementedError requiring implementation

open_questions: How to implement numeric model/transform/render for grouping by key and computing count/sum/mean?
How to implement category features mapping vocabulary to boolean columns per key?
How to implement time features extracting first/last/span from integer times per key?
How to orchestrate run_all.py to execute components in dependency order?
How to implement final_report.py to compute sha256 and attention list?
